code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Full-width colored bars mark vertical fill bands inward from each bar.
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        vals=[v for v in set(row) if v!=max(set(row), key=row.count)]
        # locate contiguous non-background bar of length >=2 at an edge segment
        for c in range(w):
            v=row[c]
            if v==max(set(row), key=row.count): continue
            lo=c
            while lo>0 and row[lo-1]==v: lo-=1
            hi=c
            while hi+1<w and row[hi+1]==v: hi+=1
            if hi-lo+1>=2:
                # paint aligned columns away from bar, using 7
                if r==0: rows=range(1,h)
                elif r==h-1: rows=range(0,h-1)
                else: continue
                for rr in rows:
                    for cc in range(lo,hi+1):
                        if grid[rr][cc] not in (v,): out[rr][cc]=7
                break
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]==2: out[r][c]=4
    return out
'''
